title: State consciousness, as against creature and transitive consciousness

statements.text: Creature consciousness is a creature being awake and mentally responsive. Transitive consciousness is being conscious of something. State consciousness is a property of mental states themselves, the difference between a thought, perception or feeling that is conscious and one that is not, and it is the question higher-order theories address.

sources.quote: We may call this the problem of state consciousness. It is this question that higher-order theories of consciousness address.
A creature's being conscious consists, roughly, of its being awake and being mentally responsive.
